printf '%s\n' '--- inherited ACLs and ownership ---'

printf '%s\n' '--- reviewer read/write ---'

runuser -u designer -- cat "$sample/specification.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- visitor denial ---'
if runuser -u visitor -- ls "$base" >/tmp/visitor.out 2>/tmp/visitor.err; then
  printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: visitor listed project'; exit 1
else
  printf 'visitor list denied: '; cat /tmp/visitor.err
fi
if runuser -u visitor -- cat "$sample/specification.txt" >/tmp/visitor.out 2>/tmp/visitor.err; then
  printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: visitor read document'; exit 1
else
  printf 'visitor read denied: '; cat /tmp/visitor.err
fi
if runuser -u visitor -- sh -c 'printf bad >> "$1"' sh "$sample/specification.txt" >/tmp/visitor.out 2>/tmp/visitor.err; then
  printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: visitor wrote document'; exit 1
else
  printf 'visitor write denied: '; cat /tmp/visitor.err
fi
printf '%s\n' 'PASS: inheritance, reviewer read/write, designer ownership, and visitor denial verified'
